date.as_written: samvat 625 mārggaśira śukla ekādaśī, (359 bhāga v3) aśvinī nakṣatra variyānyoga, somavāsare

purpose: bhāgavata saṃpūrṇṇana ṅeṅā dina (completion of listening to the recitation of the Bhāgavata)
notes: The colophon notes that the hearing (ṅeṅā) of the entire Bhāgavata was completed on this day, caused to be recited/told (hlācakā) by Devakī Ṭhakuriṇī.
